note: Curated optional-model registry. Pinned to exact upstream release assets; sha256 digests are the ones published by the upstream project on its official GitHub release (verified against the GitHub API Oct 26). A checksum proves the download matches the release — it is NOT proof the publisher is trustworthy. License entries are honest flags, not legal clearance.

models.label: vs-mlrt Neural Models (RIFE interpolation + others)
models.purpose: Neural frame interpolation (RIFE) and other neural restoration models for the vs-mlrt ONNX runtime. The macOS ONNX backend (core.ort / libvsort.dylib) is already installed; this pack provides the model weights.
models.compatibleBackend: core.ort (vs-mlrt macOS ONNX build — installed locally; upstream no longer ships macOS binaries)
models.licenseStatus: REVIEW REQUIRED: the pack bundles converted model weights that retain their upstream licenses (RIFE upstream: Apache-2.0 per hzwer/RIFE; other models vary). Redistribution rights of the converted pack are NOT yet verified for our distribution. Per-user on-demand download is the intended flow; bundling into our DMG requires license review.

adapterAsset.note: Python adapter scripts (vsmlrt package) — same upstream release; installs the RIFE wrapper the runtime needs

models.recommendationNote: Supported default for neural interpolation on this Mac: vs-mlrt ONNX Runtime (CPU/CoreML execution) + this model pack. Classical motion-compensated interpolation (mv.BlockFPS) needs no download and is the bundled alternative.
